opening.argument: The opportunity is presented as a paid path into mining, beginning with the purchase of an educational package rather than participation at no cost. The speaker states, “you enrolled as tycoon member 5000 euro you got 60,000 tokens for free in your package,” then explains that the tokens “will then go into the mining pool” and that participants can “go into the mining and get generated coins.” The promotional structure goes further: commissions are earned for referring miners, and building a team is said to offer “basically no limits to what you can make.” Branded slides reinforce the same package-to-token and mining sequence, while the speaker connects package purchases to commissions and urges viewers to join. Together, these are paid mining and recruitment-based earning claims, presented with exceptionally expansive earning potential.
